decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the ____________ wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions, the proposal, because of its design and appearance, would relate well to its site and would not harm either the appearance or setting of the property, the surrounding area or the living conditions of neighbours. The proposal would preserve the character and appearance of the Spring Grove Conservation Area. The proposed development therefore complies with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas),H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Residential Extension Guidelines of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to the house
